page.layout: One column of italic list lines, centred in the page; catchword "Missa" at the lower right. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: Columbæ lignæ in die Pentecostes ex alto demissæ.
Dies festi infiniti, mandati sub pœna excommunicationis
Fraternitates. Festum corporis Christi, quo circumgestatur idolum Maozim in pompa theatrica. Facies Veronica.
Figura crucis digitis supra frontem & pectus facienda.
Horæ Canonicæ. Herbæ consecratæ, quibus fugantur Cacodæmones.
Imagines crucis indulgentiarum: & imagines cateræ, ut sanctorum & inprimis beatæ Virginis Mariæ, redemtricis & salvatricis.
Imaguncula Sanctorum, pannis involuta per quadragesi- mam seu crepundia.
Imago crucis, quæ Agnus Dei dicitur, de quo suprá-
Initium Euangelij S. Iohannis, inclusum certis Schedulis, ac de collo suspensum.
Missæ privatæ quæ in singulis templorum angulis fiunt, pro vivis & mortuis.
Missa de corona spinea. Missa de tribus clavis.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is visible at the right margin and was left out. Small symbol marks stand before "Maozim", "Agnus Dei" and "Missæ" (a sign like a cup or hook, probably a printer's mark or Greek/Hebrew-style sign); they could not be read, so they are omitted here. The line "suprá-" ends with a printed hyphen and the next line starts a new entry, so the hyphen is kept as printed. The catchword "Missa" at the lower right is kept as printed.
